description: codebase-kg hooks. Every gate is a hook of type mcp_tool on the plugin's second MCP server, codebase-kg-hooks: a local relay Claude Code starts with the session, which lists no tools, passes each hook call to the shared codebase-kg server and answers an empty result itself when that server gives none. So a hook starts no process, and a server that is away, older or slow costs no failure notice on every tool call: the user gets one line when the gates go off and one when they return. (1) A PreToolUse hook on Grep, Glob, Bash and PowerShell (tool kg_hook_pre), which holds the search gate and the push gate. The search gate: a Grep/Glob (or shell grep/rg/git grep/find) of a directory that holds mapped code is denied with the instruction to query the code graph first. A graph query clears the next gate_credit searches; the server counts the queries itself, per session, and a server restart resets the count. A search that names its files, one aimed outside the code the graph maps, one that can only match non-source files (plists, images, Xcode project files), and a repeat of a denied search (the same pattern, however reworded) are all free. Inside a subagent the gate adds the instruction as context instead of denying. When the server is unreachable the search is allowed. (2) A PostToolUse commit check on Bash and PowerShell `git *` commands (tool kg_hook_commit_check): after a command that made a commit, the server lists the committed source no node covers, the deleted source the graph still anchors on and the mapped source that changed since the graph was updated, as context for the agent, with the instruction to run /codebase-kg:refresh and commit the graph in a follow-up commit before pushing. It is advisory, never blocks, and says nothing when the server is unreachable. Both honor .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (search_gate, gate_credit, gate_shell_search, commit_check, root, graph_path), and both no-op when the repo has no graph. SKIP_KG does not apply to either hook: search_gate: off in the per-clone file turns the gate off. (3) The push gate, in the same PreToolUse hook as the search gate: a `git push` (also `git -C <dir> push`, chained or env-prefixed) is denied while any mapped file is stale against HEAD, with the instruction to run /codebase-kg:refresh, commit the graph and push again without asking the user. An agent cannot skip the check on its own: a push prefixed with SKIP_KG=1 or a matching KG_STALE_ACK=<n> gets permissionDecision ask, so the user is asked in the permission prompt with the stale files listed, also when permissions are bypassed, and a run with no user is refused. --no-verify does not skip it. A second PreToolUse hook on the six graph write tools answers allow (tool kg_hook_allow_write), so a refresh does not stop at a permission prompt. Both fail open when the server is unreachable; the git pre-push hook still blocks. (4) A SessionStart notice: a repo that committed the vendored checkers but whose clone has no core.hooksPath or diff.codegraph.textconv gets one line naming the install command, and a clone whose graph diff driver names a missing plugin folder gets one line naming /codebase-kg:setup. It never wires a clone — git leaves .git/config out of a clone so that cloning cannot cause code to run, and wiring it automatically would route around that. In a wired clone whose diff driver pins an older codebase-kg release, it moves the pin to the installed release once that tag is published, and prints one line. (5) A SessionStart server start: when nothing answers GET /health on the server_port setting, or a server this copy may replace does (a release replaces a lower version), it starts this build's shared server detached and waits up to 8 s; it prints one line only when the port belongs to another program, the server does not come up, or this copy is not a release and another build holds the port. (6) The SessionStart server start also registers the session with the agent's process id. The server drops a session whose process has exited, so no SessionEnd hook is needed: a server that has seen a registered session exits after CODEBASE_KG_SESSION_GRACE seconds (default 300) with none live and no use.
